name: smwmusic-kirby-s-return-to-dream-land-aurora-area
title: Kirby's Return to Dream Land - Aurora Area
description:
Upbeat and melancholic song from KRTDL, could fit ice levels or boreal forest levels or anything that has an aurora as a background.

Not compatible with Blargg/Thunder or Bonus End. Also, if you pause, the melody line will cut out, so it is recommended to disable pausing or use a patch to avoid cutting out the music in a level using this song.
